name: com.haruchanz64.character-motor
description: Barebones modular character controller framework for Unity 6 supporting 3D CharacterController, 3D Rigidbody, and 2D Rigidbody2D (Platformer and Top-Down) with pluggable IMotorModule pipelines, camera reference frames, and UI Toolkit debugging.

samples.description: Example IMotorModule scripts (dash, coyote jump, sprint modifier) and barebones FPS/TPS camera controllers.
